'''Rosa Dayette''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Rosa's Shop''' in the '''Kojeara''' system of the [[Colonia]] region. She specialises in suit utility and energy management alongside weapon range, sights, and recoil control.<ref name="inara-rosa">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/37/ Rosa Dayette — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-rosa">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Rosa_Dayette Rosa Dayette], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

Frontier introduced Rosa with the four Colonia Odyssey Engineers and identifies them as providers of suit and personal-equipment modifications for commanders working on low-atmosphere worlds.<ref name="frontier-colonia">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/galnet/the-view-from-colonia The View from Colonia], Frontier Developments, 29 October 2021. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

Rosa's workshop is at '''Rosa's Shop''', a surface Engineer base on '''Kojeara 4 b''' in the '''Kojeara''' system. The body is approximately 2,530 light-seconds from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-rosa-shop">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/427488/ Rosa's Shop — Station], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

The workshop is in the Colonia region, roughly 22,000 light-years from Sol. No system permit is required.

== Discovery and access ==

=== Discovery ===

Rosa is common knowledge and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-rosa" />

=== Workshop unlock ===

Sell a combined total of '''10 Culinary Recipes or Cocktail Recipes''' to stations in the '''Colonia system'''. Any combination of the two Data types counts toward the total.<ref name="inara-rosa" />

The sales must be made at stations in the system named Colonia, not merely at stations elsewhere in the wider Colonia region.

Station services may not appear immediately after the unlock completes. If necessary, return to the main menu and re-enter the game.<ref name="inara-rosa" />

== Services ==

Rosa installs four suit modifications and three handheld-weapon modifications.<ref name="inara-rosa" />

=== Suit modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Enhanced Tracking
| Extends the range and increases the speed of the suit's basic scan.
|-
| Extra Backpack Capacity
| Increases the suit backpack's Data, Component, and Item capacity.
|-
| Improved Battery Capacity
| Increases the suit battery's energy capacity.
|-
| Reduced Tool Battery Consumption
| Reduces energy consumed by supported suit-tool functions.
|}

=== Weapon modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Greater Range
| Extends a weapon's effective range.
|-
| Scope
| Adds a scope or improves an existing sight.
|-
| Stability
| Reduces weapon recoil.
|}

Suit and handheld-weapon modifications are permanent once installed. The equipment must have an unused modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits are paid at the workshop. See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for equipment grades, modification slots, material handling, and the installation process.

== Reputation and referrals ==

Odyssey Engineers do not use the Grade 1–5 workshop-reputation system used by ship Engineers. Once Rosa is unlocked, her available modifications can be installed immediately when the equipment and material requirements are met.

Providing Rosa with '''10 Manufacturing Instructions''' Data completes her direct referral requirement toward [[Yi Shen]].<ref name="inara-rosa" /> Yi Shen becomes available only after the separate referral requirements from [[Baltanos]], [[Eleanor Bresa]], and Rosa Dayette have all been completed.
